question: Cyprus assumed the rotating presidency of the European Union for a six-month term beginning in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nicosia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Cyprus assumed the rotating presidency of the European Union with a high-level meeting held in Nicosia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This is the second time Cyprus has held the EU Council presidency since joining the EU in 2004.**
 
• **The inauguration meeting in Nicosia was attended by Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa.**
 
• **Cyprus highlighted its role as a bridge between Europe and the Middle East, with regional leaders attending the ceremony.**
 
• **The presidency focuses on strengthening EU autonomy and advancing European integration amid global challenges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zelenskiy’s participation signalled continued EU support for Ukraine as the Russia-Ukraine war enters its fourth year.**
 
• **Cypriot President Nikos Christodoulides emphasised EU strategic autonomy as a key priority of the presidency.**
